title: The Soul Mender's First Primer
summary: A first primer for the newly formed soul that teaches the cool palm and the first ways to close small soul wounds and steady a patient.

title: A Handbook of Gentle Soul Care
summary: A handbook of plain care for scraped and bruised souls with a fray-easing stroke and a quiet reading of the patient's glow.

title: The Quiet Thread Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on drawing a single fine thread of soul force through a torn place until the edges lie together.

title: Elementary Soul Stitching
summary: An elementary course in stitching the small breaks of the soul with steady counts and a guard to hold the work.

title: The Patient's Companion
summary: A short companion for the one who sits with a wounded soul and keeps it warm while it knits.

title: A Workbook of Calming Currents
summary: A workbook of slow soul currents that quiet panic and fever of the spirit and teach the healer to read them.

title: Essays on the Mending Glow
summary: Short essays on the warm glow a healing soul gives off and how to turn it onto an ally's hurt.

title: The Early Waking Primer
summary: A primer for the rare early-awakened soul that holds a soul before the body is ready and so teaches gentle care and little force.
notes: Early Awakening Basic manual (Part 4 Area 2.4; Rule 42.16.4.3)
